name: Sicilian Defense
principles: Challenge White's central control with flexible pawn breaks and rapid development.
Coordinate development before expanding on the queenside.
plansWhite: Develop Nf3 and d4 to challenge the center and open lines.
plansBlack: Fight for d4 control and choose a setup (Najdorf, Dragon, Classical) after development.
commonMistakes: Delaying kingside development while chasing early pawn grabs.
Allowing central binds without active counterplay.
